说起归天剑，这玩意有点来头。

归天剑不是神器，是一把非常出名的邪剑，杀伤力不比那些神器差。

虽说是邪剑，但是想要得到它的人那也是数以万计，当时搅得修真界好一阵腥风血雨。

因为闹得动静太大，惊动了仙界，被仙界派人下来将其封印。当时仙界的人是想将其毁灭的，可这种剑，怎么可能随随便便就被毁灭了，没办法才将其封印的。

不久前突然传出归天剑出世的消息，时笙当时就在附近，本来是想去围观那些人被归天剑虐，谁知道最后她竟然拿到了归天剑。

剧情中这把剑也会出世，而且拿到手的人还是叶清秋的死对头，所以……

这剧情君，依旧在把她往死路上逼。

真是哔了狗！

宗门大比在即，修真界的人纷纷往桐山派赶，不时就能看到御剑从头顶飞过的一大批修真者。

剧情中这场大比是在缥缈宗举行的，可是缥缈宗现在实力下降，没有资格举办宗门大比，这才改在桐山派。

时笙和凤辞不紧不慢的步行前往桐山派，前来参加宗门大比的都是以门派为单位，很少见到像他们这种两人组合的队伍。

所以偶尔会有好奇的神识从天上扫下来，一些看清了人的，差点从飞剑上掉下来。

麻麻，下面的是妖女商殊和那个杀人不眨眼的大魔头啊！他们怎么会在这里？是想等各大宗门齐聚一网打尽吗？

修真界的人都以大魔头称呼凤辞，因为没人知道他的名字。知道的，也早就被烧成了灰烬。

所以，等时笙和凤辞到的时候，整个桐山派严阵以待，三步一岗五步一哨，那架势，非常的壮观。

“哟，这么大的阵仗迎接我啊！”时笙那一脸‘我很满意，干得不错’的表情，让虎视眈眈的一溜人皆是一阵无语。

谁特么在迎接你啊！

要点脸！

“妖女！你想干什么？”桐山派掌门站了出来，义愤填膺，“今日各大门派都在此，你休想放肆。”

“这话说得，我是那么凶残的人吗？”时笙无辜的眨眼。

你是啊！

“我们这么多人还怕你两个人不成？”桐山派旁边的人喊了一声，“妖女，你速速离开，我们可不与你计较。”

“可是我不想离开啊！”时笙为难的看着那人，“你们要是看不顺眼，可以离开，我一定不会拦你们的。”

众人：“……”这是他们的地盘，凭什么要他们离开啊！

Speaking of the Guitian Sword, this thing has some background.

The Guitian Sword is not a divine weapon, it is a very famous evil sword, and its lethality is no worse than those divine weapons.

Although it was an evil sword, there were tens of thousands of people who wanted to get it, and it caused a bloody storm in the world of cultivation.

Because it made too much noise, it alerted the Immortal World, and the Immortal World sent people down to seal it.At that time, the people in the immortal world wanted to destroy it, but how could such a sword be destroyed so casually? They had no choice but to seal it.

Not long ago, news suddenly spread that the Guitian Sword was born. Shi Sheng was nearby at the time. She originally wanted to watch those people being tortured by the Guitian Sword, but who knew that she actually got the Guitian Sword in the end.

This sword will also appear in the plot, and the person who gets it is Ye Qingqiu's mortal enemy, so...

This plot guy is still driving her to death.

What a beeping dog!

The sect competition is coming soon, and people from the cultivation world rush towards the Tongshan sect. From time to time, they can see a large number of cultivators flying over their heads with swords.

In the plot, this competition was held in the Piaomiao Sect. However, the Piaomiao Sect's current strength has declined and it is not qualified to hold the sect competition, so it was changed to the Tongshan Sect.

Shi Sheng and Feng Ci walked leisurely to the Tongshan Sect. Those who came to participate in the sect competition were all from sects. It was rare to see a two-person team like them.

So occasionally curious spirits would sweep down from the sky, and some who saw people clearly almost fell off their flying swords.

Mom, those below are the enchantress Shang Shu and the big devil who kills people without blinking an eye!Why are they here?Do you want to wait for all the major sects to gather together and catch them all in one fell swoop?

People in the world of cultivation call Feng Ci the big devil because no one knows his name.Those who knew it would have been burned to ashes long ago.

Therefore, when Shi Sheng and Feng Ci arrived, the entire Tongshan Sect was ready, with three steps, one post, five steps and one sentry. The posture was very spectacular.

"Hey, such a big battle is waiting for me!" Shi Sheng's expression of "I'm very satisfied, I did a good job" made everyone who was staring at him speechless.

Who the hell is greeting you?

Want some face!

"Witch! What do you want to do?" The leader of Tongshan Sect stood up, filled with righteous indignation, "All the sects are here today, you can't even think of being presumptuous."

"That makes sense, am I such a cruel person?" Shi Sheng blinked innocently.

You are!

"There are so many of us, why are we afraid of just two of you?" The person next to the Tongshan faction shouted, "Witch, please leave quickly, we won't argue with you."

"But I don't want to leave!" Shi Sheng looked at the man in embarrassment, "If you don't like it, you can leave. I will definitely not stop you."

Everyone: "..." This is their territory, why should they leave?
